about: The cents sign Kokoro drops, read as cents (loop B138, CROSS X-050; BookLyre's 7 cases from EpubToM4B tests/fixtures/spoken_currency.json b285dd9d, in Backseat's own spoken numbers, plus toll/store cases). '50¢' is 'fifty cents', '1¢' 'one cent', 'a 5¢ stamp' 'a five cent stamp' (singular after a/an before a word). '$1.99¢' is left to the money pass (the stray ¢ stays and is silent), as BookLyre leaves it. Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / CentsSign (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/pronunciation_test.cpp).
